id="RFC-0002" title="AWS Access Triage Slack Bot" status="Draft" inferred=false
author="Donald Gifford" created="2026-05-10"
summary="Stand up a Slack bot in `#aws-access-support` that triages AWS access errors pasted by dev…"
problem="The org has ~1,500 developers across 200+ AWS accounts authenticating via Okta-federated S…"
proposal="A Slack bot in `#aws-access-support` (and bot-allowed in any team channel on @-mention) th…"
alternatives=0 risks=9 criteria=14 open-questions=0 references=7

risk line=491
  risk="Hallucinated SCP / role / policy names"
  impact="High — incorrect routing, dev sent on wild goose chase"
  likelihood="Medium without controls"
  mitigation="All specifics must come from tool results; structured tool I/O; periodic Langfuse evals on assertion-grounding"

risk line=492
  risk="Pasted secrets persisted in logs"
  impact="High — credential exposure"
  likelihood="High without controls"
  mitigation="Secret scanner runs first; original paste never persisted; redacted version only"

risk line=493
  risk="Confident wrong answers eroding trust"
  impact="High — devs stop using the bot"
  likelihood="Medium"
  mitigation="Confidence thresholds, explicit \"I'm not sure\" path, escalate-to-human always one click away"

risk line=494
  risk="Cross-tenant info leakage"
  impact="High — privacy / compliance"
  likelihood="Medium"
  mitigation="Identity-aware filtering on every tool result; per-channel allowlist; audit trail"

risk line=495
  risk="Prompt injection via paste content"
  impact="Medium — bot misbehavior"
  likelihood="High (hostile pastes are easy)"
  mitigation="Pasted content as tool-result data only, never appended to system prompt; structural separation"

risk line=496
  risk="LLM cost runaway under volume spike"
  impact="Medium — budget overrun"
  likelihood="Medium"
  mitigation="Phase 1 is LLM-free; Phase 2 has bounded tool budget; per-day cost cap with auto-degrade to deterministic-only"

risk line=497
  risk="Bot becomes critical path, fails noisily"
  impact="Medium — outages block support"
  likelihood="Low"
  mitigation="Bot is additive to existing human triage, not a replacement; graceful degradation to \"post a message saying I'm down\""

risk line=498
  risk="SCP / framework owner data goes stale"
  impact="Medium — wrong routing"
  likelihood="Medium"
  mitigation="Owner registry sourced from Backstage catalog, single source of truth; periodic reconciliation"

risk line=499
  risk="Devs use bot to probe other teams' access"
  impact="Low — abuse"
  likelihood="Low"
  mitigation="Identity-aware filtering, audit trail, channel allowlist"

  text="Deep investigation invoked on <10% of threads (the residual hard cases, not the bulk)"

  text="Cited cause in ≥80% of policy-change tickets, traceable to the tool result"

  text="≥90% of exception tickets routed to the correct framework owner on first try"

criterion line=536 executable=false command=""
  text="Reduction in `#aws-access-support` human-triager hours per week (track via Slack analytics + on-call rotation surveys)"
